reviews.review:
The game is fun and entertaining. For the first playtrough I would say the bosses are a bit weak but the whole experience is worth it's money. Hope more and more expansions will arrive. But lets make it a bit more deatailed shall we?
-The game looks good enough for me. Nothing ground breaking but its still make me stop here and there to look around and adimre the view. The guns are also visually pleasing. I kinda like that all of them are taken from reality and were cyberized. 
-Sound are mostly ok. The weapon sounds are a bit weak for my taste but that won't ruin the game.
-Combat is entertaining. I did not try all aspects at the moment just used the long range heavy hitter tactics (marksman) but damn sniper rifles gives you a feeling of authority. Still the game demands you to upgrade otherwise enemies can grow on your head as you progress.  I was lucky with my drops and there are a few items that would make my game way harded with their absence.
-Story, i keep it short: meh... there is something you can munch on and also a pont that's really cool but I dont wanna spoil it. 

In total: If you liked Remant fta and II this game should be on your list. Also worth a try if you like soul like games.

Actual decent game with some flaws, but still pretty underrated.

Be prepared for a lot of cheap deaths by teleporting, in your face spawning, or shield-using enemies though.
Best game you've never heard of. Very similar to remnant 1 and 2. Not as polished and a bit clunky but worth picking up if you enjoy souls like games. Definitely an underrated game!
